item.title: Australia: Quantum Computing for Remote Grid Optimisation
item.description: Flinders University has secured AU$1.45 million in federal funding to develop a quantum computing demonstrator aimed at optimising remote, distributed, hybrid, microgrid and renewable energy systems efficiently and reliably.

item.title: India Expands Digital Health Impact Domestically and Globally
item.description: India advances its digital health and telemedicine ecosystem through innovation, international collaboration and strategic partnerships, strengthening domestic care and supporting global healthcare development.

item.title: Singapore Strengthens Its Role in the Global Quantum Value Chain
item.description: Singapore is strengthening its quantum ecosystem by scaling advanced hardware manufacturing capabilities, deepening global collaborations and advancing research translation under its National Quantum Strategy.

item.title: Malaysia: Digital Monitoring Secures Electricity Distribution
item.description: Malaysia is actively leveraging smart meters, transformer-level monitoring, and digital technologies to detect electricity theft, improve grid oversight, and enhance transparency in energy management.

item.title: The Philippines: DICT Empowering Filipino Youth in a Digital Era
item.description: The nation is keen to equip Filipino youth with practical digital skills and robust online safety measures to ensure they can learn, grow, explore, innovate and engage responsibly in a connected world.

item.title: Australia: SmartSat Project Advances Satellite Autonomy
item.description: SmartSat autonomy project develops algorithms enabling satellites to plan imaging, manage resources and operate more independently during defence and Earth observation missions.

item.title: Thailand: Smart Innovation for a Future-Ready Industrial Ecosystem
item.description: Thailand is leveraging AI, automation and smart innovation to transform industrial estates and laboratories, driving sustainable growth, workforce development and nationwide competitiveness.

item.title: Hong Kong Researchers Enhance Perovskite Solar Cell Efficiency
item.description: Researchers at the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology developed a vacuum-deposited perovskite solar cell with improved crystal orientation, achieving high efficiency, durability and production potential.

item.title: Vietnam: Advertising Technology Powers Tourism Boom
item.description: Vietnam’s tourism sector is rapidly recovering and growing, with advertising technology enabling precise targeting, higher-value travellers and more personalised, data-driven marketing strategies nationwide.

item.title: Singapore: Advancing Applied AI with New Centre of Excellence
item.description: Singapore launched a new applied AI centre while outlining plans to strengthen national AI talent development, advanced sustainable data centres and resilient digital infrastructure under forthcoming legislation.
